scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --format=iife --global-name=VolunteerScheduling --platform=neutral --target=es2019 --main-fields=module,main --outfile=dist/apps-script/Code.js && node scripts/expose-appsscript.mjs && cp src/server/appsscript.json dist/apps-script/appsscript.json
scripts.deploy:server: npm run build:server && clasp push --rootDir dist/apps-script
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy:server
